Tosafot on Bava Batra 60a:2:1.hebrew: לקח בית בחצר אחרת לא יפתחנה לחצר השותפין - פירוש: אפילו לביתו, כדי שלא יכנס ממנו לחצר השותפין:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 60a:2:1.english: [If he] bought a house in another courtyard, he may not open it into the shared courtyard - Explanation: [He may not open it] even [from the other courtyard] into his own house, so that he not enter from it into the shared courtyard.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 60a:5:1.hebrew: ראוין הללו שתשרה שכינה עליהם - מסיפיה דקרא דריש, דכתיב: "ותהי עליו רוח אלהים":
Tosafot on Bava Batra 60a:5:1.english: "These are worthy that the Divine Presence rest upon them" - He derives it from the end of the verse, as it is written: "And the spirit of God was upon him."
